info.title: Blockline MEV Analytics API
info.description: Professional MEV analytics API for Solana. Analyze transaction context, detect front-running, identify sandwich attacks, and gain competitive intelligence on Solana MEV activity.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API Key authentication. Format: `sk_live_xxx` (production) or `sk_test_xxx` (testing). Obtain your API key from the [Blockline Dashboard](https://blockline.soltop.sh/dashboard/api-keys).

SupabaseJWT.description: Supabase JWT authentication. Used for MEV Analysis and Write Locks endpoints. Requires an active subscription (trial, active, or grace_period status).

poh_tick_offset.description: PoH tick distance from victim (negative = before)

interaction_type.description: Type of sandwich leg (only sandwich incidents are returned)

pool_address.description: DEX pool where the interaction occurred

success.description: Whether the attacker's transaction executed successfully

found.description: Whether the transaction was found in timing_data

sandwich_detected.description: Whether a sandwich attack was detected

success.description: Whether the victim's transaction executed successfully

slot_range_used.description: Slot range used for the analysis

slot.description: Solana slot number when transaction was processed

entry_index.description: Index of the entry within the slot

tx_index.description: Index of the transaction within the entry

is_vote.description: Whether this is a vote transaction (0=false, 1=true)

accounts_read_count.description: Number of accounts read by the transaction

accounts_written_count.description: Number of accounts written by the transaction

post.description: Analyzes all transactions that touched a specific account (market) within ±N slots of your transaction. Shows PoH tick offsets to understand who traded before/after you. Essential for front-running and sandwich attack detection.

account_id.description: The market/account ID you were trading on (base58, 32-44 characters)

slot_range.description: Number of slots before/after to search

start_time.description: Unix timestamp - start of time window to search for original transaction (optional filter)

end_time.description: Unix timestamp - end of time window to search for original transaction (optional filter)

slot_offset.description: Negative = before, 0 = same slot, Positive = after

poh_tick_offset.description: PoH tick difference from your transaction

details: signature format is invalid (expected base58, 87-88 chars)

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

example.details: API key is invalid or has been revoked
Active subscription (trial, active, or grace_period) required

example.message: Rate limit: 6 requests per minute. Please try again later.

post.description: Backfills transaction data for a given signature and account into the analytics database. Useful for ensuring specific transactions are tracked and analyzed within a specified slot range. The backfill runs asynchronously and returns immediately with a request ID for tracking.

account.description: The market/account ID to analyze (base58, 32-44 characters)

slotRange.description: Number of slots before/after to analyze

message.example: Backfill initiated. Check logs for completion status.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific transaction including slot, timestamp, success status, fee, tokens involved, and market information with human-readable labels and tags.

leader.description: Validator pubkey that produced the block

example.details: No transaction found with signature: abc123...

post.description: Fetches transaction signatures for a wallet with intelligent caching, pagination, and time filtering. Features 5-minute cache TTL, custom time windows (within 7 days), and efficient RPC batching. Returns lightweight signature data that can be enhanced with other endpoints.

before.description: Signature to paginate from (for subsequent pages)

start_time.description: Unix timestamp - start of time window (must be within 7 days)

end_time.description: Unix timestamp - end of time window (must be within 7 days)

hint_signature.description: Signature to start RPC fetching from (optimization hint)

next_before.description: Use as 'before' parameter for next page

post.description: Fetches detailed transaction metadata from Solana RPC including fees, error status, and balance changes. Complements /analyze-trade by providing financial details for each transaction signature. Shows SOL/token balance changes, fees, and success/failure status focused exclusively on the transaction signer. Features 48-hour Redis caching.

example.details: No transaction found with signature: abc123...

post.description: Check one or more transaction signatures for sandwich attacks within a configurable slot range. Submits an async job and returns a jobId. Poll `/mev/job-status/:jobId` for results. Results are cached for 5 minutes. Uses RPC pre-lookup for efficient ClickHouse partition pruning. Detection covers cross-slot and intra-slot (same PoH tick) ordering via entry_index/tx_index.

slot_range.description: Slot range (±) to search for attackers. 0 = intra-slot only.

200.description: Job submitted or cached result returned

message.example: Sandwich check started. Poll /mev/job-status/:jobId for updates.

value.details: signatures is required (string or array of strings)

post.description: Synchronous sandwich check for a single transaction. Returns the result directly with no job queue or polling required. Uses tighter parameters for speed: ±1 min timestamp window (vs ±5 min), max ±10 slot range. Ideal for quick single-transaction lookups. Results are cached for 5 minutes.

slot_range.description: Slot range (±) to search for attackers. 0 = intra-slot only. Max 10.

get.description: Poll for job status and retrieve results when complete. Used for check-wallet, check-attacker, and check-sandwich jobs. Job states: waiting (queued), active (processing), completed (results available), failed (error occurred).

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Job ID returned from check-wallet, check-attacker, or check-sandwich endpoint

data.description: Analysis results (structure depends on job type)

example.details: No job found with ID: abc123def456

post.description: Analyze write lock patterns for a specific Solana account, showing timeline of write locks, conflict events, competing transactions, and hot scores. Queries can take 2-5 minutes for large time ranges. No caching - queries run fresh against ClickHouse. Requires one of three query modes: time_range, slot, or start_date/end_date.

time_range.description: Query mode 1: Time range (mutually exclusive with slot or start_date/end_date)

slot.description: Query mode 2: Specific slot number (mutually exclusive with time_range or start_date/end_date)

start_date.description: Query mode 3: Start of custom date range - Unix timestamp in seconds (requires end_date, mutually exclusive with time_range or slot, max 7 days)

end_date.description: Query mode 3: End of custom date range - Unix timestamp in seconds (requires start_date, max 7 days range)

unique_signers.description: Number of unique wallets accessing the account

write_locks_timeline.description: Time series of write lock counts per slot

conflict_timeline.description: Time series of conflict events per slot

competing_transactions.description: Up to 100 most recent competing transactions

value.details: Must provide exactly one of: time_range, slot, or start_date/end_date

post.description: Discover the hottest accounts with the most write lock contention across the entire Solana network. Returns ranked list with hot scores and heatmap data for the top 20 accounts. Very expensive queries - can take 2-5+ minutes. No caching. Requires either time_range OR slot parameter.

time_range.description: Query mode 1: Time range (mutually exclusive with slot)

slot.description: Query mode 2: Specific slot number (mutually exclusive with time_range)

limit.description: Number of hot accounts to return

200.description: Ranked list of hot accounts with heatmap data

heatmap_data.description: Time-bucketed access patterns for top 20 accounts (up to 1000 data points)

value.details: Must provide either time_range or slot
Cannot provide both time_range and slot

post.description: Scan a wallet's recent DEX trades for sandwich attacks. Uses a hybrid ClickHouse/RPC approach: fetches transaction history via RPC, enriches with ClickHouse timing data, and detects sandwich patterns. Submits an async job — poll `/mev/job-status/:jobId` for results. Max 4 days, max ±10 slots. Results cached for 10 minutes.

slot_window.description: Slot window (±) for detecting attackers. 0 = intra-slot only.

200.description: Job submitted or cached result returned

total_transactions.description: Total wallet txs in time range

post.description: Analyze a specific attacker's sandwich activity against a victim wallet. Returns statistics: sandwiches by DEX, by validator/client, by pool, timing patterns, and % of victim trades sandwiched. Reuses cached check-wallet data when available.

200.description: Job submitted or cached result returned

total_victim_dex_trades.description: Total victim DEX trades in range

victim_trades_sandwiched_pct.description: % of victim trades sandwiched by this attacker

trades.description: Trades where this attacker sandwiched the victim

value.details: attacker_address and victim_address must be different
